cause: A PowerShell Get-Content call omitted -Encoding UTF8 after the generator had been written without BOM. The ASCII logic and CSVs remained valid, but subsequent script edits persisted misdecoded Chinese note/README strings.
correction: Move both Chinese texts to explicit UTF-8 template files, read all sources with explicit encoding, assert expected Chinese content and complete Markdown links after generation. Keep corrupted output bytes and the failed generator as history.
